prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: native64 RPG complete-figure animation source sheet. Image1 is the exact CURRENT frontal game drawing and the authority for identity, proportions, physical size, materials, colors and lighting. Image2 is the already established lateral locomotion of the SAME specimen, useful for its real limb count, joints, supports and gait; do not copy its side-view camera. Draw the exact same creature in a new FOUR-column by FOUR-row sheet of SIXTEEN separate COMPLETE figures, true transparent background, equal cells with generous padding. Keep the physical head/torso/limb scale identical throughout ALL rows, with the same head/body ratio, appendage count, armor and asymmetrical details. Constant upper-left game lighting, readable compact painted pixel-art masses matching the reference, no added photorealistic detail, no glow changes, and no brown or colored fringe around the transparent edge. Preserve large and small morphologies, never humanize nonhumanoids or give a floating/worm creature human legs. Match limb count and actual articulations from both references. The new cycle faces UP with a true BACK, DOWN with a true FRONT, then returns to a FRONT neutral of the SAME body. Back must show genuine rear anatomy, rear helmet/armor/panels and rear joints rather than a second face or front kneecaps; retain radial anatomy if appropriate. Preserve every existing carried object and attach it to the correct limb without duplicates. No new gear, powers, species features, ground shadow, scenery, text, labels or grid lines. Draw whole coherent figures, not shifted leg strips, shears or grafted limbs. Keep torso proportions, scale and foot/support baseline consistent; a tiny natural gait bob is allowed. Bipeds alternate compact grounded steps; quadrupeds/many-legged creatures alternate their own actual supports; continuous bodies progress by gentle coherent body undulation; floating ones drift gently without invented feet.
Exact order: ROW1 FRONT neutral standing/resting, FRONT first support contact, FRONT recoil, FRONT passing/support. ROW2 FRONT same neutral, FRONT opposite support contact, FRONT recoil, FRONT passing/support. ROW3 TRUE BACK neutral/resting, BACK first support contact, BACK recoil, BACK passing/support. ROW4 TRUE BACK same neutral, BACK opposite support contact, BACK recoil, BACK passing/support. Neutral means the creature's actual coherent rest pose with supports grounded or its normal hover posture. Keep limbs distinct, no duplicates, no crops. This is the SAME existing specimen in all16 cells, not a redesigned species.
Specimen identity for traceability: MON-008, Démon. The images, not this generic label, define its exact anatomy.
Critical: the two rear rows must actually rotate the specimen 180 degrees, with its face/mouth and all front-facing markings on the far hidden side. Anatomical asymmetries change screen side between front and back.
